description: Schema documents that MUST be rejected (docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1, §1.3, §3.4 rule 8). A conforming implementation MUST NOT parse these documents at all: the digest covers only the parsed model, so an ignored key or a duplicate field would let two different documents share a digest.

vectors.description: A record declaring field 'a' twice.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 4 (field names MUST be unique)

vectors.description: The record node spells 'name' twice; the two spellings disagree, so the document must not parse.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §3.4 rule 8 (JSON parsing rejects duplicate object keys)

vectors.description: A trailing comma inside the 'fields' array is not valid JSON.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1 (a schema is a JSON document, so malformed JSON is rejected)

vectors.description: Truncated document: the 'fields' array is never closed.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1 (a schema is a JSON document, so malformed JSON is rejected)

vectors.description: The empty string is not a JSON document.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1 (the root node MUST be a record, so a missing document is rejected)

vectors.description: Two JSON values in one document: the parser must not silently ignore the second.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1 (a schema document holds exactly one JSON value)

vectors.description: The root node is an array, not a record.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (the root MUST be a record)

vectors.description: The root node is the bare string "string".
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (the root MUST be a record)

vectors.description: A bare type name that is not a primitive, envelope or multi-envelope: named type references are not supported in this version of the model.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 6 (no named type references; nested records and enums must be declared inline)

vectors.description: A primitive written as an object instead of the bare JSON string of §1.2.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (primitives are JSON strings, not objects)

vectors.description: An object type node without the required 'type' key.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (every object node carries a 'type' key)

vectors.description: A record name starting with a digit.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 1 (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$)

vectors.description: A field name containing '$'.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 1 (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$)

vectors.description: A namespace segment with a hyphen, which the §1.3 rule 2 grammar does not allow.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 2 (dot-separated ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ segments)

vectors.description: An explicitly present but empty namespace does not match the §1.3 rule 2 grammar.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 2 (namespace, if present, MUST match the namespace grammar)

vectors.description: A messageType with no '@'.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 3 (messageType MUST match the §1.3 rule 3 grammar)

vectors.description: A messageType whose version part is empty: the grammar requires at least one character after '@'.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 3 (messageType MUST match the §1.3 rule 3 grammar)

vectors.description: A nested record declares a messageType; only the root record may.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 7 (at most one messageType declaration, on the root record only)

vectors.description: A record node carrying a key that is not part of the node shape. Ignoring it would let two documents with different content share a digest.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (a record node has exactly the keys type/name/namespace/messageType/fields)

vectors.description: A record without the required 'fields' key.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (a record node has the required 'fields' array)

vectors.description: A record without the required 'name' key.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (a record node has the required 'name')

vectors.description: 'fields' is a JSON object rather than an array.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (a record's 'fields' is an array of field objects)

vectors.description: A field entry that is an array rather than an object with name and type.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (every entry of 'fields' is a field object)

vectors.description: A field entry without the required 'type' (there are no optional fields in this model, §1.3 rule 5).
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 / §1.3 rule 5 (all fields are required and carry a type)

vectors.description: A field entry carrying an 'optional' key, which the model does not have (§1.3 rule 5).
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 / §1.3 rule 5 (a field entry has exactly name and type)

vectors.description: An array node without the required 'items' type.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (an array node has the required 'items')

vectors.description: A map node without the required 'values' type.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (a map node has the required 'values')

vectors.description: An enum with no symbols.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 4 (an enum's symbols MUST be unique and non-empty)

vectors.description: An enum declaring 'A' twice.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 4 (an enum's symbols MUST be unique and non-empty)

vectors.description: An enum symbol that is not an identifier (§1.3 rule 1 applies to symbols too).
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 1 (enum symbols match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$)

vectors.description: An enum symbol that is a JSON number.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (every symbol is a JSON string)

vectors.description: 'symbols' is a JSON string rather than an array.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (an enum's 'symbols' is an array of strings)

vectors.description: An enum node without the required 'symbols' array.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (an enum node has the required 'symbols')

vectors.description: An object node with an unrecognized 'type' keyword.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.1 (the node kinds are record/enum/array/map plus the bare-string kinds)

vectors.description: An Avro-style union (an array of types) as a field type: there are no unions or optional fields in this model.
vectors.rejectionRule: docs/SCHEMA.md §1.3 rule 5 (no unions and no optional fields; every field carries exactly one type)
